title: Double-tap jump while flying exits flight and drops to platformer
description:
New control (extends DD-008): while the hero is in FlightState, pressing JUMP twice in quick succession (a double-tap within a short window) exits flight. "Stop flying" = DROP TO PLATFORMER: leave FlightState, gravity returns, the hero falls and resumes ground movement (lands into MoveState, exactly like the existing landing-exit path).

Context from the codebase map: today flight is ENTERED by a second jump press in the air (scripts/fsm/states/jump_state.gd:69-78, gated on the electricity ability + not flight-suppressed, via InputGate.just_pressed("jump")). FlightState (scripts/fsm/states/flight_state.gd) has NO gravity and currently only exits on landing (is_on_floor -> MoveState) or flight suppression (DD-011 anti-magic zone). This ticket adds a third, player-driven exit: a double-tap of jump WHILE flying.

Design / implementation notes for the developer (confirm idiomatic against the godot-game-dev skill):
- Detect the double-tap INSIDE FlightState: count two InputGate.just_pressed("jump") edges within a small window (e.g. ~0.30s, a named tunable const). The window/threshold must be a named constant so it is unit-testable and tunable.
- On the second edge within the window -> transition_to("MoveState") (the same target as the landing exit, so gravity/fall is applied as a pure fall, consistent with the existing comment at flight_state.gd:70-72). Do NOT introduce a new falling state unless review finds MoveState insufficient.
- Must use the InputGate seam for the jump edge (deterministic in tests, per TASK-024 / memory gut-flake-await-input), NOT Input directly.
- Must NOT break the ENTER-flight mechanic: a normal single second-jump from JumpState still enters flight. The exit double-tap lives in FlightState only.
- Must NOT create a flight-bypass of the gates: dropping to platformer can only ever REMOVE flight, never grant traversal — verify against the gating-with-flight-from-spawn safety (anti-magic zone, FIRE gate, 98px boss gap). Corridor metrics for sector_01/02 stay byte-identical (no level edits expected).
- Document the new control in docs/DECISIONES-DISENO.md (extend DD-008).

Tests-first (GUT, model on test/crucial/test_movement_transitions_crucial.gd + FakePlayer): (a) two jump edges within the window while in FlightState -> transition_requested(FlightState, "MoveState"); (b) a SINGLE jump edge in flight does NOT exit; (c) two jump edges SEPARATED BY MORE THAN the window do NOT exit (window expiry); (d) regression: a second jump in JumpState still enters FlightState. Add the double-tap-exit test to the crucial subset.
acceptance_criteria: While in FlightState, two JUMP presses within the defined double-tap window cause an exit to MoveState; gravity returns and the hero falls/lands (drop-to-platformer).
A single jump press while flying does NOT exit flight; two presses separated by more than the window do NOT exit (window expiry honored). The window/threshold is a named, tunable constant.
The existing ENTER-flight mechanic is preserved: a second jump press from JumpState (electricity unlocked, not suppressed) still transitions to FlightState.
No new flight-bypass: the drop only removes flight, never grants traversal; sector_01/02 corridor + boss-gap metrics stay byte-identical and the flight-gate/anti-magic-zone tests stay green.

Jump edges are read through the InputGate seam (deterministic). New GUT tests cover enter-still-works, double-tap-exits, single-press-no-exit, and window-expiry; the exit test is in the crucial subset. Full GUT suite green, gdlint clean. DD-008 updated in docs/DECISIONES-DISENO.md.
